description: This file defines the SubjectNotModifiableException class, a custom exception used in the context of policy management within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a subject could not be modified due to insufficient permissions and includes mechanisms for building instances from messages or JSON data.

classes.name: SubjectNotModifiableException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an attempt to modify a subject without proper permissions, extending DittoRuntimeException, and implementing PolicyException.

classes.name: SubjectNotModifiableException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of SubjectNotModifiableException with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized with policy ID, label, and subject path.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.
